tasks.gr10-adjustments-financial-statements: Topic: Adjustments and financial statements. Cover depreciation, accruals, prepayments, bad debts, final accounts, statement of comprehensive income, statement of financial position. Ask about adjustment journals, statement layouts, figure selection.
